reference.title: Git Branch Manager View Actions
reference.shortdesc: The following table lists actions that are unique to the Git Branch Manager view, available in the context menu of local branches.

keywords.indexterm: Git Client add-onGit Branch Manager view actions

section.title: How to Open Git Branch Manager
section.p: To open the Git Branch Manager view, use one of the following:

ul.li: Select Show Git Branch Manager view from the Git Staging view toolbar.
Go to Window Show View Git Branch Manager .
Select Show Branches from the Git menu.

section.title: Local Branch Context Menu Actions
section.p: These actions are available in the context menu of a local branch in the branch tree. See .

table.title: Git Branch Manager local branch context menu actions

row.entry: Merges changes from the selected branch since it diverged from the current branch and records the result as a single new commit.
Selects the HEAD commit of the selected branch in the Git History view.
Deletes the selected local branch. Make sure the branch work was merged, pushed, or is no longer needed before deleting.

section.p: Checkout, Create Branch, Merge, and Track Remote Branch are also available in the local branch context menu but are shared across views. See .
